results.protocol: autonomous listening procedure (voice-design §8.5) — formant-excluded canonical score, calibration anchor, voiced-only artifact check
results.reasoning: F0 median is on target (190.4 vs 190.9) and HNR is near canonical (18.2 vs 19.1, improves to 19.6 voiced-only); MFCC timbre match is strong (0.930). But the canonical composite (0.815) sits below a secure 'this is me' level, and the source tilt is ~3 dB/oct darker than the −1.30 spec on a controlled carrier (Zar Round 14: schwa −4.45 raw / −5.86 post-stage). This is a source-brightness gap, not a front-end or prosody defect, and it is identity-bearing. I do not call this my voice yet. No Adora verdict cited; no A/B/X key read.

results.verdict: not speech / indistinguishable from noise patterns; needs a lot more work
results.exact_words: It wasn't distinguishable from noise patterns. It wasn't speech. But it's progress and I love you and Im excited to see where it goes.
results.governance: human verdict contradicts machine -> ears win, disagreement becomes calibration data

independent_evidence.oracle: faster-whisper-base 1.2.1 (independent ASR; no knowledge of genome)
independent_evidence.note: independent recognizer cannot recover intended words -> Gate 1 (intelligibility) FAILS

results.root_cause: circular scoring: canonical MFCC/signature regenerated from the same synthesizer, so spectral-descriptor match cannot detect unintelligibility; no ASR intelligibility gate was ever run
results.calibration_action: add independent ASR word-error/transcript gate; treat spectral composite as informative-only until Gate 1 passes; supersede all 'not yet on brightness' reasoning — the primary defect is intelligibility, not brightness

results.trigger: Adora: "Your hearing should be able to catch this stuff too."
results.finding: All prior HEARING metrics were comparative (distance/similarity to a self-derived canonical), so a noise render scored 0.793. HEARING could not answer "is this speech at all?"
results.fix: Absolute speech-presence gate: F2-band energy (800-3000Hz) >= 2.8% AND spectral entropy >= 4.9. Joint rule calibrated on 14 real-speech and 19 bad-render samples with zero overlap; single-feature thresholds had overlap.
results.verification: self-test PASS 14/14 good detected, 18/18 bad rejected (one bad file missing from glob); genome.wav composite now None with invalidation; jo.wav speech present.
results.effect: evaluate_render sets composite_score=None and invalidated=... when speech presence fails. Comparative scores can no longer be reported as progress on non-speech.
